ChildFund India × MORPH._Code
01
The starting point

Not every child
gets the same start.

A child's ability to learn, grow and realise their potential is shaped by more than their ambition or ability.

Some children have access to books, good schools, the internet, supportive teachers and a stable environment. Others face barriers such as financial insecurity, limited learning resources, unsafe surroundings, discrimination or exploitation.

The difference isn't always what a child is capable of. It's the opportunities and support available to them.

ChildFund India × MORPH._Code
02
The communication opportunity

The opportunity is to make a
complex mission easier to understand.

ChildFund India's work addresses a broad and interconnected challenge.

The opportunity is to create experiences that help people understand the issues, connect with the mission and see where they can participate.

Move people from knowing that inequality exists to understanding why it matters — and what they can do about it.

ChildFund India × MORPH._Code
03
The principle that guides the work

Every child needs
some sort of dignity.

A child's circumstances should never define their worth.

We believe stories should recognise children's agency, potential and individuality — not reduce them to their hardships.

Dignity is not an additional consideration. It is the starting point.

ChildFund India × MORPH._Code
04
Our communication philosophy

We don't turn someone's hardship into a sob story.

There is a difference between showing people that a problem exists and making them feel connected to the people affected by it.

Show circumstances without exploiting them. Recognise barriers without defining children by them.

The aim is empathy without exploitation. Awareness without pity.

ChildFund India × MORPH._Code
05
What the communication needs to do

Move people from awareness to participation.

People encounter hundreds of messages every day. Most are seen, scrolled past and quickly forgotten.

An experience asks something different of them, giving people an opportunity to participate and make a choice.

We don't just want people to see the message. We want to give them a reason to engage with it.

ChildFund India × MORPH._Code
06
The MORPH._Code operating system

We start with behaviour,
not advertising.

Before deciding what a campaign should look like, we ask a more fundamental question:

What do we want people to do, experience or understand?

The creative is not the starting point. It is the vehicle for the behaviour we want to encourage.

ChildFund India × MORPH._Code
07
Our operating system

Behaviour → Integration →
Emotional trigger → Conversion

01 / BEHAVIOUR

Start with something people already understand or naturally engage with.

02 / INTEGRATION

Build the campaign message naturally into the interaction.

03 / EMOTIONAL TRIGGER

Create a moment connecting the experience to real-world circumstances.

04 / CONVERSION

Give people a clear next step to participate and contribute.

Activation 01

When the Odds Are

What if, for once, the odds were actually in your favour?

An unrigged claw machine where visitors don't leave until they win — turning an arcade attraction into a conversation on unequal opportunities.

ChildFund India × MORPH._Code
10
Activation 1 · The campaign idea

When the Odds Are
in Your Favour.

An unrigged claw machine. One simple rule: you don't leave until you win.

A familiar arcade experience becomes an unexpected way to start a conversation about unequal opportunities.

A small change in the rules can make all the difference. Imagine what that could mean in a child's life.

ChildFund India × MORPH._Code
12
The human insight

Some people play with a
different set of rules.

People know that claw machines can be difficult to win. Yet they continue to play, drawn by anticipation.

For some children, access to education and books is part of everyday life. For others, those same things feel out of reach.

The challenge isn't that children aren't trying hard enough. It's that they aren't all playing by the same rules.

ChildFund India × MORPH._Code
13
The physical experience

One machine. One rule.
You don't leave until you win.

We bring the idea to life through a specially designed, unrigged claw machine in high-footfall locations.

Visitors purchase a participation ticket and get unlimited attempts until they win a prize.

The odds are genuinely in their favour.

ChildFund India × MORPH._Code
14
The reveal

The experience doesn't end
when someone wins.

Once a participant wins, the campaign reveals its real message.

They are told this machine was designed to give them a fair chance. Then we connect that experience to children facing stacked odds in their education and futures.

If changing the rules can change a game, imagine what fairer opportunities change in a child's life.

ChildFund India × MORPH._Code
15
The participant's choice

Play. Win. Choose what
happens next.

The participant has a choice: keep the prize or voluntarily return its value toward ChildFund India's work.

Participation fees and returned prize values are handled transparently per agreed terms.

The point isn't obligation. It's giving people the opportunity to choose.

ChildFund India × MORPH._Code

Campaign amplification

A campaign that starts offline
and travels digitally.

BEFORE

Influencers introduce the machine as an unusual arcade experience with unlimited wins.

DURING

Participants encounter the machine, experience the reveal and make their choice.

AFTER

Content assets connect the experience to ChildFund India's mission.

ChildFund India × MORPH._Code
20
Activation 2 · The digital game

A game against the
odds.

What if the harder you tried to build something, the more the world tried to pull it apart?

A digital game inspired by 16-bit puzzle mechanics where players stack red blocks to reveal an image while white elements disrupt progress.

A simple game mechanic becomes a metaphor for the barriers children face building futures.

ChildFund India × MORPH._Code
22
How the game works

Every time you make progress,
something pulls you back.

Players stack red blocks to complete lines and gradually reveal a hidden campaign image.

White elements enter the grid and disrupt progress, removing parts of the revealed image and forcing the player to rebuild.

The more progress they make, the more they have to protect.

ChildFund India × MORPH._Code
23
The game mechanics

Build progress. Face disruption.
Start again.

RED BLOCKS — PROGRESS

Blocks the player stacks to complete lines and gradually reveal the campaign image.

WHITE ELEMENTS — SETBACKS

Disrupt progress and remove image parts — representing real barriers like financial insecurity.

ChildFund India × MORPH._Code

The message stays.

Designed around an eventual loss, the game transitions into a real-world message.

Turn gameplay experience into lasting awareness and support.
